name: Codex Voice Builder
move: terminal typing becomes kinetic semantic typography, dives into a voice control, then pulls back through a product canvas
how: A faithful compressed reconstruction of the Codex voice-builder reference film. A floating browser types the opening question, camera-matched panels replace software/without/writing/code, an extreme zoom makes the microphone pill the entire frame, then an expo pullback reveals the landscape prompt and floating product windows. All type, cursor, waveform and camera values are deterministic functions of time.
adapt: Replace opening copy and product cards; retain the semantic one-idea-per-frame hierarchy and 0.8–1.2s expo focus moves.
port: Mount scoped scene layers and drive seek(t) from a shot proxy; camera targets use Motion.
caveats: Condenses a 28-second reference into its 12-second motion grammar
Programmatic DOM reconstruction; no source frames
